about: The one or two events that define a famous year, written for GeoHistory. They only affect ranking: an event of that year whose name matches is listed first in the year panel. Nothing is added to the data by this file; a line that matches no event is reported by the build and has no effect.
source: General knowledge; every entry is an event already in the data with its own Wikidata item or curated source.

headlines.match: ^first arrival of Christopher Columbus to America$
